# GelAnlasalim B2B Procurement and Live Reverse Auction Arena

GelAnlasalim is a next-generation B2B procurement marketplace where corporate buyers run live reverse auctions to purchase materials, logistics, and professional services from verified suppliers at the lowest bids.

## Core Features
- **Live Reverse Auctions:** Buyers set up specifications and launch auctions; suppliers compete live by submitting lower bids in real-time.
- **Verified Supplier Network:** Document-based supplier profiles checked for corporate credentials.
- **Detailed Analytics:** Bid tracking, comparison charts, and savings logs.

## Important Pages & Routes
- [Homepage (/)](https://gelanlasalim-v2.vercel.app/): Main landing page with trust badge, live active auctions, and FAQ section.
- [Abonelik (/abonelik)](https://gelanlasalim-v2.vercel.app/abonelik): Premium subscription packages, features, and USD pricing tables.
- [Entegrasyonlar (/entegrasyonlar)](https://gelanlasalim-v2.vercel.app/entegrasyonlar): Integrations catalog with ERP, SAP, and payment gateways.
- [Sozlesmeler (/sozlesmeler)](https://gelanlasalim-v2.vercel.app/sozlesmeler): Platform user agreement, KVKK policies, and legal frameworks.
